Man dies in car explosion after attacking girlfriend in Karnataka

In Tumakuru district, Karnataka, a man died when a car exploded after he allegedly attacked his girlfriend with a knife. Police stated the man intended to abduct the woman. The explosion occurred when he used a petrol bomb, resulting in his death at the scene. The injured woman survived.
